<?php
/**
 * Target page definitions for the 2026 approved Agadir Concept mockups.
 *
 * @package AgadirConceptDesignUniverses
 */

namespace Agadir_Concept_Design_Universes;

defined( 'ABSPATH' ) || exit;

/**
 * Resolves every page covered by the approved mockups.
 */
final class Page_Map {
	/**
	 * Return target definitions indexed by canonical slug.
	 *
	 * @return array<string, array<string, string>>
	 */
	public static function pages(): array {
		return array(
			'accueil'                  => self::page( 'home', 'accueil', 'Accueil' ),
			'a-propos'                 => self::page( 'about', 'a-propos', 'À propos' ),
			'services'                 => self::page( 'services', 'services', 'Services' ),
			'sites-web-professionnels' => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels', 'Sites web professionnels' ),
			'site-vitrine'             => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/site-vitrine', 'Site vitrine' ),
			'site-corporate'           => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/site-corporate', 'Site corporate' ),
			'site-catalogue'           => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/site-catalogue', 'Site catalogue' ),
			'site-e-commerce'          => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/site-e-commerce', 'Site e-commerce' ),
			'site-de-reservations'     => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/site-de-reservations', 'Site de réservations' ),
			'portail-metier'           => self::page( 'web', 'sites-web-professionnels/portail-metier', 'Portail métier' ),
			'secteurs-accompagnes'     => self::page( 'sectors', 'secteurs-accompagnes', 'Secteurs accompagnés' ),
			'offres'                   => self::page( 'offers', 'offres', 'Offres' ),
			'realisations'             => self::page( 'projects', 'realisations', 'Réalisations' ),
			'ressources'               => self::page( 'resources', 'ressources', 'Ressources' ),
			'contact'                  => self::page( 'contact', 'contact', 'Contact' ),
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Resolve a page, including hierarchical children.
	 *
	 * @param string $slug Canonical slug.
	 * @return \WP_Post|null
	 */
	public static function resolve( string $slug ): ?\WP_Post {
		$definition = self::pages()[ $slug ] ?? null;
		if ( null === $definition ) {
			return null;
		}

		$page = get_page_by_path( $definition['path'], OBJECT, 'page' );
		if ( $page instanceof \WP_Post ) {
			return $page;
		}

		$query = new \WP_Query(
			array(
				'post_type'              => 'page',
				'name'                   => $slug,
				'post_status'            => array( 'publish', 'private', 'draft' ),
				'posts_per_page'         => 2,
				'no_found_rows'          => true,
				'fields'                 => 'all',
				'update_post_meta_cache' => false,
				'update_post_term_cache' => false,
			)
		);

		return 1 === count( $query->posts ) && $query->posts[0] instanceof \WP_Post ? $query->posts[0] : null;
	}

	/**
	 * Resolve the current target definition.
	 *
	 * @return array<string, string>|null
	 */
	public static function current(): ?array {
		if ( ! is_singular( 'page' ) ) {
			return null;
		}

		$post = get_queried_object();
		if ( ! $post instanceof \WP_Post ) {
			return null;
		}

		foreach ( self::pages() as $slug => $definition ) {
			$page = self::resolve( $slug );
			if ( $page instanceof \WP_Post && (int) $page->ID === (int) $post->ID ) {
				$definition['slug'] = $slug;
				$definition['id']   = (string) $post->ID;
				return $definition;
			}
		}

		return null;
	}

	/**
	 * Return family labels.
	 *
	 * @return array<string, string>
	 */
	public static function families(): array {
		return array(
			'home'      => __( 'Accueil', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'about'     => __( 'À propos', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'services'  => __( 'Services', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'web'       => __( 'Sites web professionnels', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'sectors'   => __( 'Secteurs accompagnés', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'offers'    => __( 'Offres', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'projects'  => __( 'Réalisations', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'resources' => __( 'Ressources', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
			'contact'   => __( 'Contact', 'agadir-concept-design-universes' ),
		);
	}

	/**
	 * Build a definition.
	 *
	 * @param string $family Family key.
	 * @param string $path   Hierarchical path.
	 * @param string $label  Admin label.
	 * @return array<string, string>
	 */
	private static function page( string $family, string $path, string $label ): array {
		return array(
			'family' => $family,
			'path'   => $path,
			'label'  => $label,
		);
	}
}
